## Overview

- **Origin:** the creek  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Mary Joe is a young French girl. She has a buxom build and a broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## History

During a night when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde were away at a political rally, Mary Joe was engaged by the [Barry](../character/barry.md) family to care for [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md). While in charge, she became terrified when [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) fell gravely ill with croup. Unable to handle the medical emergency, Mary Joe dispatched [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to summon help.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_
